# Decisions

* [conformance-vs-lint](conformance-vs-lint.md) - Why only three rules can fail a bundle, and everything else is advisory.
* [binary-naming](binary-naming.md) - Why the command is `okf` while the crates are `okft*`.
* [yaml-parser](yaml-parser.md) - Why the frontmatter parser is saphyr rather than a serde YAML crate.
* [release-automation](release-automation.md) - How Conventional Commits drive versioning, and why the release notes are generated by a second tool.
* [coverage-gate](coverage-gate.md) - Why coverage is enforced at 100% and how the code is shaped to reach it.
